title: GET /api/v1/attention: result
description: Needs attention as the dashboard lists it, within the token's clusters. Rows that belong to no cluster are given to a token limited to no cluster only.

generated_at.description: Value. When the list was worked out.

fresh.description: Value. True where the readings behind the list are recent: every cluster's status read within two polls (the token's own clusters, where it is limited). False is how a monitor sees that the manager has stopped reading; the list may then be missing rows.
